meta.config: Rev D (design): 8 identical lift points on the edge-truss joint-pair centres (x 928.5, 4456.5, 7543.5, 11071.5, both sides), each one vertical hanger strap pair (2 x 50 x 1.5 G450, both faces) from a saddle head over the roof edge truss down to a 120 mm cradle at the truss joint pair under it (two 3 mm cheeks, 2 x M16 bearing bolts under the joints; screwed at the first joint, bearing only at the second), so each lift point is settled by statics; saddle heads with no fasteners, keyed along the module by a stop block; floor edge trusses and the north roof edge truss in 1.15 mm; 4 screws per truss joint, gussets sized joint by joint, cleats 5 + 5 at every truss end, tie plates, floor and roof strap bracing and bridging; no temporary parts; pinned-beam cascade set to the measured CoG; design cases R1, R2, R4, 8 tilt cases at 2 deg and 4 sideways cases; skew, short-sling and slack-sling cases reported as information

R1_rigid.label: Rigid lifting frame, 8 slings of exact equal length and no stretch

R4_equalised.label: Equalising rig (beam cascade): four equal sling forces on each side, sides by statics

R7a_outer_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (outer high): robustness margin on the shares

R7b_inner_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (inner high): robustness margin on the shares

R7c_one_end_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (one end high): robustness margin on the shares

R7d_twist.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (twist): robustness margin on the shares

T1_roll_S.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T2_roll_N.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T3_pitch_W.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T4_pitch_E.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T5_SW.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T6_SE.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T7_NW.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the north-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T8_NE.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the north-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)
